narrative.coaching_note: Clean your hands after you touch the bedside area before you touch anything outside it, that is the one change to make next time. You touched bed rail A with your bare hand starting at 0.5 seconds, and that MRSA moved to your hand. You then touched call button starting at 3.4 seconds and phone starting at 6.6 seconds, so the contamination moved to both of those surfaces. You missed hand hygiene after the patient zone at 5.8 seconds and again at 18.7 seconds, which left your bare hand, your gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, and phone still contaminated at the end. Next time clean your hands before you put on gloves at 10.9 seconds and avoid touching phone with gloved hand as you did at 19.3 seconds.
narrative.audit_summary: Source was bed rail A (patient_zone_A). Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 0.5s with transfer to bare hand, then to call button at 3.4s and to phone at 6.6s; gloved hand contacted bed rail A at 11.1s after donning at 10.9s. Two Moment 5 opportunities were missed at 5.8s (bare hand) and 18.7s (gloved hand); compliance 0/2 overall and 0/2 for Moment 5, with no opportunities for Moments 1, 2, or 4 and no hygiene events. Glove use issues included no hygiene before donning and gloved contact with phone in the healthcare area. Contaminated at end: bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, and phone with Use an EPA List H registered disinfectant (effective against MRSA).
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 5.8 seconds.
